definition.interfacial: paper mode: water dc conductivity plus water/solid high-frequency permittivity only; no pore or membrane increment
definition.pore: paper mode: water dc conductivity plus delta_sigma_pore only; solid phase is zero
definition.membrane: paper mode: water dc conductivity plus delta_sigma_membrane only; solid phase is zero
definition.all: paper mode: water dc conductivity and permittivity plus pore and membrane increments; solid phase has high-frequency permittivity
